m: पुल् cl. 1. 10. 6. P. पोलति, पुलति, पोलयति, to be great or large or high, to be piled or heaped up, Dhātup. xx, 11; xxxii, 61.
a: पुल् — {c1c} {c6c} P., {c10c} U. (पोलति, पुलति, पोलयति-ते) 1 To draw or pull out. --2 To be great. --3 To be lofty. --4 To be collected together, be gathered.

brevity, abbreviation, compendium, L.

a: पुलाकः --कं — 1 Empty, bad or shrivelled grain; Ms. 10. 125. --2 A lump of boiled rice. --3 Abridgment, compendium. --4 Brevity, conciseness. --5 Rice-water. --6 Despatch, celerity. --7 Smallness.

मारुते वेधसि ब्रघ्ने पुंसि कः कं शिरोऽम्बुनोः। स्यात्पुलाकस्तुच्छधान्ये संक्षेपे भक्तसिक्थके॥

m: पुलाक—कारिन् mfn., making haste, hastening
पुला˚किन् m. a tree, L.

m: पुलह m. (पुल + √ 2. हा) N. of an ancient Ṛṣi (one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā enumerated among the Prajā-patis and seven sages), AV.Pariś.; Pravar.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (IW. 517 n. 1)

N. of Śivi, Śivag.
a: पुलहः — N. of a sage, one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā; Ms. 1. 35.

a: पुलकीकृत — a. Thrilled with joy, rejoiced.

m: पुलक m. a species of edible plant, MBh.
a species of tree, L.
(pl.) erection or bristling of the hairs of the body (considered to be occasioned by delight or rapture rather than by fear), Kāv.; Pur. (also n. but mostly occurring ibc. and ifc. with f(आ). )
a bunch (see तृण-प्˚)
a kind of stone or gem, Var.
flaw or defect in a gem, L.
a kind of insect or vermin, L.
a cake of meal with which elephants are fed, L.
orpiment, L.
a Gandharva, L.
N. of a prince, VP.
of a Nāga, L.

horripilation (cf. above)
a: पुलकः — 1 Erection or bristling of the hairs of the body, a thrill (of joy or fear), horripilation; चारु चुचुंब नितंबवती दयितं पुलकैरनुकूले Gīt. 1; मृगमदतिलकं लिखति सपुलकं मृगमिव रजनीकरे 7; Amaru. 57, 77. --2 A kind of stone or gem. --3 A flaw or defect in a gem. --4 A kind of mineral. --5 A ball of food with which elephants are fed (गजान्नपिंड). --6 Yellow orpiment. --7 A wine-glass. --8 A species of mustard. --Comp. --अंगः the noose of Varuṇa. --आलयः an epithet of Kubera. --उद्गमः erection of the hairs of the body, horripilation.

m: पुल˚कय Nom. P. ˚यति, to have or feel the hair of the body erect (with rapture or delight), Gīt.

a: पुलकयति — Den. P. To have the hairs of the body erect, thrill (with joy &c.).

m: पुल—केशिन् and पुल—केशि-वल्लभ, m. N. of princes, L.

v: tri॰ pulaka + matvarTe iti । 1 romAKayute striyAM NIp । 2 DArAkadambe pu॰ rAjani॰ ।
m: पुल˚किन् mfn. = ˚कित, W.
पुल˚किन् m. Nauclea Cordifolia, L.
a: पुलकिन् — a. (नी f.) Having the hairs of the body erect &c. --m. A species of Kadamba tree.

m: पुल˚कित mfn. having the h˚ of the b˚ erect, thrilled with joy, Kāv.; Pañc.; Hit.
a: पुलकित — a. Having the hairs of the body erect, thrilled with joy; hence, rejoiced, enraptured.

m: पुल˚कित—सर्वाङ्ग mf(ई)n. having the whole b˚ covered with bristling hair, Pañc.

पुल˚कोद्गम m. erection of the hair, Bhartṛ.
पुल˚कोत्कम्प mfn. trembling with a thrill of delight, Kathās.
पुलस mfn. g. तृणादि.

a: पुलस्तिः --स्त्यः — N. of a sage, one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā; Ms. 135.

m: पुलस्˚त्याष्टक n. N. of wk.

m: पुलस्˚त्य m. N. of an ancient Ṛṣi (one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā; also enumerated among the Prajā-patis and seven sages, and described as a lawgiver), AV.Pariś.; Pravar.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (IW. 517 n. 1)

m: पुलिन m. n. (g. अर्दर्चादि) a sandbank, a small island or bank in the middle of a river, an islet, a sandy beach (ifc. f(आ). ), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the bank of a river (= तीर), Ragh., Sch.
पुलिन m. N. of a mythical being conquered by Garuḍa, MBh.
of a poet, Cat.
a: पुलिनः --नं — [पुल्-इनन् किच्च; Uṇ. 2. 53] 1 A sand-bank, sandy beach; रमते यमुनापुलिनवने विजयी मुरारिरधुना Gīt. 7; R. 14. 52; sometimes used in pl.; कालिंद्याः पुलिनेषु केलिकुपितामुत्सृज्य रासे रसं Ve. 1. 2. --2 A small island left in the bank of a river by the passing off of the water, an islet. --3 The bank of a river.

k.v: तोयोत्थितं तत्पुलिनं सैकतं सिकतामयम्. निषद्वरस्तु जम्बालः पङ्कोऽस्त्री शादकर्दमौ॥

पुलिन—प्रदेश m. situation or place of an island, Kathās.

m: पुलिन—वती f. (prob.) N. of a river g. अजिरादि.

(in music), N. of a Rāga.

s: puM, (pula mahattve + “kuRipulyoH kindac .” uRA॰ 4 । 85 । iti kindac .) caRqAlaBedaH । sa ca mlecCaSabdavAcyaH । ityamaraBaratO ॥ tasyotpattiryaTA, -- pulastya uvAca । “evaM gatezu trElokyaM dAnavezu purandaraH । jagAma brahmasadanaM saha devEH SacIpatiH ॥ tatrApaSyat sa deveSaM brahmARaM kamalodBavam । fziBiH sArdDamAsInaM pitaraM svaYca kaSyapam ॥ tato nanAma SirasA SakraH suragaREH saha । brahmARaM kaSyapaYcEva tAMSca sarvvAMstapoDanAn ॥ provAcendraH surEH sArdDaM devanATaM pitAmaham । pitAmaha ! hftaM rAjyaM balinA valinA mama ॥ brahmA provAca SakrEtat Bujyate svakftaM Palam । SakraH papracCa Bo brUhi kiM mayA duskftaM kftam ॥ kaSyapo'pyAha deveSa ! BrURahatyA kftA tvayA । dityudarAttvayA garBaH kfto vE bahuDA balAt ॥ pitaraM prAha devendro mAturdUzaRato viBo ! । karttanaM prAptavAn garBo yadaSOcA hi sABavat ॥ tato'bravIt kaSyapastu mAturdoze sadAsatAm । gatastato vinihato dozo'pi kuliSena BoH ॥ tacCrutvA kaSyapavacaH prAha SakraH pitAmaham । vinASaM pApmano brUhi prAyaScittaM viBo ! mama ॥ brahmA provAca deveSaM vaSizWaH kaSyapastaTA । hitaM sarvvasya jagataH SakrasyApi viSezataH ॥ SaNKacakragadApARirmADavaH puruzottamaH ॥ taM prapadyasva SaraRaM sa te Sreyo viDAsyati ॥ sahasrAkzo'pi vacanaM gurURAM sa niSamya vE । provAca svalpakAlena kasmin prApyo bahUdayaH ॥ tA UcurdevatA marttye svalpakAle bahUdayaH ॥ “ityevamuktaH surarAqviriYcinA marIciputtreRa ca kaSyapena । taTEva mitrAvaruRAtmajena vegAnmahIpfzWamavApya tasTO ॥ kAlaYjarasyottarataH supuRyastaTA himAdrerapi dakziRasyAm । kuSasTalAt pUrvvata eva viSruto vasoH purAt paScimato'vatasTe ॥ yatrATa cakre BagavAn murAriMrvAstavyamavyaktatanustvamUrttiH । KyAtiM jagAmATa gadADareti mahAGavfndasya SitaH kuWAraH ॥ yasmin dvijendrAH SrutiSAstrasaMyutAH samAnatAM yAnti pitAmahena । marutpitFn yatra ca saMprapUjya BaktyA tvananye nahi cetasEva । PalammahAmeDamaKasya mAnavA laBantyanantyaM BagavatprasAdAt ॥ mahAnadI yatra surarzikanyA bAlApadeSAdDimaSElametya । cakre jagat pApavinazwamagryaM sandarSanaprASanamajjanena ॥” tatra SakraH samaByetya mahAnadyAstawe'dBute । ArADanAya devasya kftvASramamavasTitaH ॥ prAtaHsnAyI tvaDaHSAyI ekaBaktirhyayAcitaH । tapastepe sahasrAkzaH stuvan devaM gadADaram ॥ tasyEvaM tapyataH samyak jitasarvvendriyasya ca । kAmakroDavihInasya sAgraH saMvatsaro gataH ॥ tato gadADaraH prIto vAsavaM prAha nArada ! । gacCa prIto'smi Bavato muktapApo'si sAmpratam ॥ nijaM rAjyaYca deveSa ! prApsyasi tvacirAddivaH । yatizyAmi yaTA Sakra ! BAviSreyo yaTA tava ॥ ityevamukto'Ta gadADareRa visarjitaH snApya manoharAyAm । snAtasya devasya tataH purastAt saMprocurasmAnanuSAsayasva ॥ provAca tAn BIzaRakarmmakArAn nAmnA pulindA mama pApasamBavAH । vasaDvamevAntaramadrimuKyayorhimAdrikAlAYjarayoH pulindAH ॥ ityevamuktvA surarAw pulindAn vimuktapApaH surasidDayakzEH । saMpujyamAno'nujagAma cASramaM mAtustadA DarmmanivAsamAdyam ॥” iti vAmane 73 aDyAyaH ॥
